recipes.title: Equator Coffees — Hario V60
recipes.description: Equator Coffees' V60 guide for one 10 oz cup: 24 g at 1:15, a 60 g bloom and three even 100 g pours thirty seconds apart.

steps.instruction: place the Hario V60 filter in the brewer and rinse it with hot water, then discard the water — this removes any paper taste and preheats the brewer
grind the coffee on a medium-fine setting, towards the fine side from the centre of the grinder; place the grounds in the filter, tapping or lightly shaking to level them
place the brewer and cup or carafe on a scale and tare to 0
start the timer and pour 60 g of hot water into the centre of the grounds to start the bloom
pour 100 g of water starting in the centre of the grounds, slowly circling outward; do not pour onto the very edge of the cone
pour 100 g more water in the same fashion

recipes.notes: Equator call for Hario V60 filters, rinsed with hot water and the rinse water discarded. The guide writes its water temperature as "just off boil at 205°" without naming a scale; Fahrenheit is the only reading the value admits. Serve once the filter stops dripping, which the guide says should happen right around 3:30. Their pro tips suggest 16:1 for a more delicate cup and a coarser grind if the brew runs past 3:00.
